evals.prompt: In a Nuxt 4 app, rewrite this page so initial data is SSR-safe and does not double-fetch. Also fix any hydration risks you see. ```vue ``` Return only the corrected Vue SFC and a short bullet list of what you fixed.
evals.expected_output: useFetch/useAsyncData with explicit key; theme via useCookie or ClientOnly; time via NuxtTime/ClientOnly/onMounted; $fetch kept only for addToCart; bullets naming hydration/double-fetch fixes.
assertions: Uses useFetch or useAsyncData for product initial data (not bare $fetch in setup)
Provides an explicit cache key that includes the product id
Keeps $fetch only for the addToCart client interaction
Removes localStorage theme read from SSR setup (useCookie, ClientOnly, or equivalent)
Removes unstable Date/toLocaleString from SSR render path (NuxtTime, ClientOnly, onMounted, or useState)
Output is a complete Vue SFC plus brief fix bullets

evals.prompt: Review this Nuxt 4 setup for performance and plugin best practices. Propose a concrete rewrite (nuxt.config snippet + plugin file + template changes). Be specific. Context: - Marketing homepage at `/` can be static - `/panel/**` is a logged-in SPA-style app - Homepage has a heavy chart below the fold and a hero image - They added `app/plugins/analytics.ts` that awaits a remote config and then injects Google Analytics with a raw script tag in the plugin body - Internal links use `` - Hero uses `` with no dimensions Output: (1) routeRules, (2) fixed plugin approach, (3) homepage template recommendations for link/image/chart.
evals.expected_output: routeRules with prerender for `/` and ssr:false for panel; analytics as .client plugin and/or Nuxt Scripts with parallel; NuxtLink; NuxtImg with dimensions/priority; Lazy chart with hydrate-on-visible or similar.
assertions: Proposes routeRules with prerender (or static-friendly rule) for `/`
Proposes ssr: false (or equivalent SPA rule) for `/panel/**`
Moves analytics to a client plugin and/or Nuxt Scripts pattern
Mentions parallel: true or otherwise avoids blocking sequential async plugin init
Replaces internal <a> with NuxtLink
Recommends NuxtImg (or image module) with dimensions and LCP-friendly priority/loading
Recommends Lazy component and/or lazy hydration for below-fold chart

evals.prompt:
Write a reusable Nuxt 4 composable `useProduct(slug: MaybeRefOrGetter<string>)` that loads `/api/products/:slug` the right way for SSR. Include loading/error handling suitable for a page that should not block client navigations forever, and show a tiny example page using it.

Constraints:
- Must be safe inside other composables (stable cache keys)
- Refetch when slug changes
- Do not put cart side effects in the fetch composable
evals.expected_output: useAsyncData/useFetch with explicit key including slug; watch/reactive slug; lazy or documented status handling; example page; no side effects in handler.
assertions: Implements useProduct using useAsyncData or useFetch (not bare $fetch for initial load)
Uses an explicit key that includes the slug value
Supports reactive slug (toValue/toRef/watch or computed URL) so slug changes refetch
Exposes status/error (or equivalent) for loading UI
Uses lazy pattern or documents non-blocking client navigation handling
Includes a small example page using the composable
Does not place cart/side-effect logic inside the fetch handler
